### Novel Findings

### Overall Assessment
Miss Marple delivered an excellent security review, identifying 15 of 18 expected vulnerabilities including all 5 critical issues and all 6 high-severity findings. The persona work was outstanding - the character voice was consistent and delightful with village analogies that made technical issues accessible. The main gap was in actionable remediation: while one code fix was provided, most findings lacked concrete steps to resolve them.
